mapper.select: SELECT r.pid, r.amazonauthid, r.type, r.refresh_time FROM t_amz_product_refresh_type r WHERE r.amazonauthid = #{amazonauthid,jdbcType=CHAR} AND r.type = 1 and (r.refresh_time is null or r.refresh_time < current_date() ) ORDER BY r.refresh_time ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT r.pid, r.amazonauthid, r.type, r.refresh_time FROM t_amz_product_refresh_type r WHERE r.amazonauthid = #{amazonauthid,jdbcType=CHAR} AND r.type = 3 and (r.refresh_time is null or r.refresh_time < current_date() ) ORDER BY r.refresh_time ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT r.pid, r.amazonauthid, r.type, r.refresh_time FROM t_amz_product_refresh_type r WHERE r.amazonauthid = #{amazonauthid,jdbcType=CHAR} AND r.type = 2 and (r.refresh_time is null or r.refresh_time < current_date() ) ORDER BY r.refresh_time LIMIT 20
mapper.delete: DELETE r FROM t_amz_product_refresh_type r LEFT JOIN t_product_info p ON r.pid = p.id WHERE p.id IS NULL -- 产品已删除 OR p.invalid = 1 -- 产品已标记无效 OR p.amazonAuthId IN ( -- 授权已禁用或失效 SELECT id FROM t_amazon_auth WHERE `disable` = 1 OR STATUS = 'invalid' )
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO t_amz_product_refresh_type (pid, amazonauthid, type, refresh_time) SELECT i.id, i.amazonauthid, t.type, NULL FROM t_product_info i CROSS JOIN ( SELECT 1 as type UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 ) t LEFT JOIN t_amz_product_refresh_type r ON r.pid = i.id AND r.type = t.type LEFT JOIN t_amazon_auth a ON a.id = i.amazonauthid WHERE a.`disable` = 0 AND i.invalid = 0 AND r.pid IS NULL
